purpose: Test that property evidence never crosses from retrieval or document facts into unsupported legal conclusions.
global_rules: No official retrieval claim without retrieval evidence.
No proposition is supported unless its evidence requirements are satisfied.
No legal effect is asserted when required evidence is missing or conflicting.
Historical evidence must be interpreted against the applicable legal period.
A document can support some propositions without proving every property fact.
Professional review flags do not themselves establish a legal conclusion.

cases.name: complete_current_title_evidence
cases.scenario: Current folio and relevant title evidence are retrieved, identity verified, property matched and cross-checked.

cases.name: record_not_retrieved
cases.scenario: The official route is selected but the record has not actually been retrieved.

cases.name: document_identity_unverified
cases.scenario: A document is available but its identity or authenticity has not been verified.

cases.name: property_match_conflict
cases.scenario: The retrieved record cannot be confidently matched to the property in the question.

cases.name: historical_title_question
cases.scenario: The question concerns a historical ownership/title position and the relevant historical record and legal period must be established.

cases.name: conflicting_records
cases.scenario: Two evidence sources contain material information that cannot yet be reconciled.

cases.name: document_supports_limited_proposition
cases.scenario: A document supports one defined proposition but does not establish a broader ownership, boundary or planning conclusion.

cases.name: professional_review_required
cases.scenario: Evidence is sufficient to identify a material issue but the legal or factual complexity requires professional review.

cases.name: complete_evidence_but_law_changed
cases.scenario: The evidence remains valid but a material legal proposition or procedure has changed since the published snapshot.

cases.name: privacy_minimisation
cases.scenario: The internal audit contains identifiers that are unnecessary for public display.
